releaseNotes:
• Vector Code Toolbar Lock: Replaced emoji with clean vector drawable icon matching professional UI styling
• Ultra-Compact PS:... Cipher: In-place 1-tap encryption (no panels), transforms typed text instantly into a short PS:code
• Auto-Decryption in Suggestions Bar: Recipients copying a PS:... message immediately see the decrypted text right above the keyboard
• Auto-dismiss on Typing: Decrypted banner vanishes instantly the moment you type any character or dismiss keyboard
• Universal Multi-Language: 100% loss-free encryption & decryption for Sinhala, English, Tamil, Emojis, numbers, multi-line
